تحتسون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَسُونَ (taḥtasūna) /taħ.ta.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
# تُحْتَسَوْنَ (tuḥtasawna) /tuħ.ta.saw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَسَى (iḥtasā)
